title: OBD-II Check-Engine and Fault-Code Capture
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT bridges.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obd:pid dtc_count>0
| stats latest(dtc_codes) as codes, latest(dtc_count) as count, max(_time) as last_seen by vin
| eval last=strftime(last_seen,"%F %T")
| sort - last_seen
description: Captures diagnostic trouble codes from an OBD-II dongle so a check-engine light comes with the actual fault codes instead of a mystery symbol.
value: Knowing the fault code before visiting a mechanic saves money and avoids being upsold; logging them also reveals intermittent faults.
implementation: Read OBD-II PIDs via a Bluetooth/Wi-Fi dongle bridged to HEC; schedule frequently and alert whenever a new trouble code appears.
visualization: Table of vehicles by current trouble codes and last-seen time.
grandmaExplanation: It reads the fault codes behind your car's check-engine light so you know what is actually wrong before the garage.
